purpose.summary: BNK1DCS is a CICS online program in the CICS Banking Sample Application (CBSA) that displays customer details on a BMS map. It also supports deleting a customer record (PF5), updating a customer record (PF10/Enter), and returning to the main menu (PF3), using CICS COMMAREA to pass state between pseudo-conversational interactions.
